senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. כָּלָא)to be restrained, to be retired.
to be retired, (cmp. כְּזַז) to be put to shame, be rebuked.
units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 9">Ab. d’R. N. ch. IX</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Numbers 12:14">Num. XII, 14</cite>) <he>שתִּכָּלֵם ז׳ ימים</he> that she should live in retirement for seven days (and not appear before the king); (<cite ref="Sifrei Bamidbar 106:1">Sifré Num. 106</cite> <he>שתהא מוּכְלֶמֶת</he>).

<cite ref="Berakhot 16b:20">Ber. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>שלא נבוש ולא נִכָּלֵם מאבותינו</he> (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 4) that we may not be put to shame and not be abashed when compared with our fathers (Y. ib. IV, 7ᵈ bot. <he>שלא נבוש מאבותינו לעו״הב</he>).
<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:14:1">Cant. R. to I, 14</cite> <he>בהִכָּלְמוֹ</he> in his shyness.

senses.gloss: to cause to retire, to rebuke, shame.
units: <cite ref="Kiddushin 31a:13">Kidd. 31ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>ולא הִכְלִימָהּ</he> and he did not scold her.
<cite ref="Kiddushin 31b:5">Ib. 31ᵇ</cite> <he>כלום … ולא הִכְלַמְתָּהּ</he> did she (thy mother) throw a bag of money into the sea in thy presence, and thou didst not reproach her?—

<cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 4:8">Midr. Till. to Ps. IV, 3</cite> <he>עד מתי אתם מַכְלִימִין וכ׳</he> how long will you slander me and my dignity?; a. e.—Part. Hof. <he>מוּכְלָם</he>, f. <he>מוּכְלֶמֶת</he>, v. supra.
